# MediaPipe (vendored)

Files here are bundled so pose detection runs fully on-device and offline.

- `vision_bundle.mjs`, `wasm/vision_wasm_internal.{js,wasm}`: from npm `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.0.1`
- `pose_landmarker_full.task`: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker (full, float16) model
